An analysis of the company's Q3 2025 financial profile reveals exceptionally strong credit fundamentals, characterized by high-margin profitability (83% gross margin and 48% operating margin), a robust liquidity position (current ratio of 1.55 on $62.1B of current assets), and a solid equity base ($23.8B). While the company exhibits immense scale with $17.6B in quarterly revenue and highly profitable operations, its leverage profile shows a relatively high liabilities-to-assets ratio of approximately 79% ($91.1B in liabilities against $114.9B in assets), which slightly restrains it from the absolute highest AAA rating. Balancing the elite operating efficiency and massive liquid buffer against this leveraged capital structure supports an upper-medium to high investment grade rating.

DECISION: AA-
